PhD
PhD research
The UvA offers a stimulating research environment where PhD candidates can develop their talents to the full. Our research is among the world’s best in many areas.
Find a PhD position
I want to pursue a PhD
What to expect from your PhD?
During a doctoral programme, you learn how to conduct independent academic research. This results in a doctoral thesis..
Is a PhD right for you?
Do you enjoy immersing yourself in a topic and exploring it in depth? Then pursuing a PhD might be a good fit for you.
How do I find a PhD position?
There are several ways to obtain a PhD position. You can apply for a vacancy or submit an open application.
What does a doctoral programme entail?
Admission
Before you can start a PhD at the UvA, you must meet a number of admission requirements.
Doctoral programme
The exact structure of your doctoral programme is determined in consultation with your supervisors at your faculty. During the doctoral programme, you will work on your research and, in many cases, also teach.
Career prospects
As a PhD candidate, you develop strong analytical skills and specialised knowledge. After completing a doctoral programme, a range of career opportunities are available.
Grants, facilities and support
As a PhD candidate at the University of Amsterdam (UvA), you can access a wide range of facilities. These include training opportunities, financial support, and help with practical matters.
What’s it like to pursue a PhD at the UvA?
